dataset: 10,000 deterministic JSON records (seed 20261002), mixed title/status/score/tags/note; 10-row subset; 200 synthetic 100 KiB high-entropy photo-sized files
postgres_shape: current-style collection_items columns plus primary key, site/collection/id and partial deleted/submitter indexes; isolated temporary tables, no production data
sqlite_shape: per-site items(id,collection,data,created_at) with collection/id index, WAL mode, fresh file and checkpoint
caution: Representative but nonidentical schemas; excludes PostgreSQL engine/base disk, includes relation/index; SQLite WAL transient; existing PostgreSQL remains; backups and dual data add space.
